def _rewrite_to_tuple(self, union):
    """Union[Tuple[V, ..., V], Tuple[V, ..., V], ...] -> Tuple[V, ...]"""
    value_type = None
    for t in union.__args__:
        if not is_generic_of(t, Tuple):
            return None
        value_type = value_type or t.__args__[0]
